learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Cardiac and Pulse Artifact.
Apply Cardiac and Pulse Artifact to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: ECG can spread to scalp channels; pulse artifact may appear when an electrode overlies a pulsating vessel.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Regular timing with ECG and characteristic morphology support identification. Independent component analysis is not a substitute for physiological confirmation.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Avoids mislabelling periodic sharp activity or connectivity.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: A perfectly rhythmic “brain” waveform at the heart rate should trigger skepticism.
